notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40166337/9f5007b4dc7547804b8c39f6bd729e4c63c88703.png[/img]

On October 1st we'll be releasing a demo of Fractured Atmosphere for Steam Next Fest! This is the first time the game will be playable to the public so we're looking forward to gathering feedback in preparation for the early access release. 

For more updates and to provide feedback, wishlist us here and follow along on social media:

Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/FracturedAtmos]@FracturedAtmos[/url]
Discord: [url=discord.gg/hb6kEVVdCX]discord.gg/hb6kEVVdCX[/url]
